Theorem
[Four-dimensional curvature control (Theorem 27.19)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0034 1. ch27:27.19\group Scalar curvature bounds

If a four-dimensional complete noncompact shrinker has bounded scalar curvature, then $|\Rm |\le C R$ and hence $|\Rm |$ is bounded.
